segments.text: To start this meditation, we can close our eyes and we can bring both our hands to the ground.
If we're sitting on a chair, we can just point both of our hands to the ground.
Let's take a deep breath in and as we breathe out, we let go of anything that is bothering us.
We can direct our attention to the Mother Earth,
the ground beneath us. Mother Earth, may we imbibe the stability from you.
May we imbibe the peace and serenity.
Mother Earth, please absorb any negative energy, any heaviness and worries within my subtle system
and that is disturbing my attention.

We bring our left hand back on the lap and our attention goes to the first chakra, the Mooladhara chakra,
And this chakra is situated at the base of our spine.
When this chakra is balanced, it helps us to feel completely connected to our innermost self, our innocence.
And that is the same place where our inner strength comes from.
The residing deity in this chakra is Shri Ganesha, who embodies all the qualities that we have within our Mooladhara.
So we can ask within.
Please may all the qualities of the Mooladhara, that being of innocence, spontaneity, fearlessness and purity, may it be awakened within me.
